definition: Number of documentation and citizenship cases involving Malaysian-born persons of Indian origin resolved to a final decision; the median case cycle time in months; AND the approval/refusal split with refusal reasons published by category
year_2_target: Verified caseload baseline published; 15 one-stop desks operational; median cycle time reduced by at least 25% against the Year 1 measured baseline; approval/refusal split published for the first time
year_4_target: At least 70% of the Year 1 verified caseload resolved to a final decision
year_6_target: At least 90% of the Year 1 verified caseload resolved to a final decision; steady-state median cycle time published; approval rate published annually with an independent sample review of refused cases
verification_source: JPN case-management system; published monthly series
disaggregation: Age band, state, applicant category (child, student, elderly, PWD, widow, single parent)
notes: A RESOLUTION target is used, NOT an approval target: approval is a discretion of the Federal Government under Article 15A, Article 19 and Second Schedule Part II and cannot be committed to a percentage. COMPENSATING CONTROL added after independent critique: a resolution target alone is satisfiable by refusing every case, so the approval/refusal split, refusal reasons by category, and an independent sample review of refusals are published alongside it. The Year 1 baseline replaces the unverifiable 25,000 estimate.

kpi_name: Preschool participation among low-income Indian children
definition: Proportion of children aged 4-5 in low-income Indian households enrolled in a registered preschool
year_2_target: Enrolment audit completed and baseline published; participation at approximately 40% of the eligible cohort
year_4_target: Participation at approximately 70% of the eligible cohort; approximately 11,200 subsidised places
year_6_target: Participation at approximately 80% of the eligible cohort; approximately 12,800 subsidised places; school-readiness screening for all programme entrants
verification_source: MOE enrolment records; annual programme audit
disaggregation: State, provider type, gender, disability status
notes: The Year 2 target is an AUDIT deliverable, not a participation claim, because no baseline exists. Doc A's 40,000 subsidised places exceeded the eligible cohort (CNF-022).

definition: Proportion of the 528 SJKT meeting the defined safety and learning-environment standard
baseline_value: Not measured; no complete audited condition record exists
year_2_target: 100% of SJKT audited and a prioritised remediation schedule published; safety-critical works commenced at all schools rated highest risk
year_4_target: All schools rated safety-critical at audit remediated; digital facility and a trained coordinator in every SJKT
year_6_target: All 528 schools meeting the defined standard
measurement_frequency: Quarterly for works; annual for standard
verification_source: MOE and PWD works records; published remediation schedule
notes: Requires MOE confirmation of the SJKT share of the national dilapidated-schools programme to avoid double-counting existing funding (VAL-11).

definition: Number of participating community-service facilities meeting defined safety and accessibility standards
year_2_target: Audit completed for participating facilities; priority works list published
year_4_target: Safety-critical works completed at priority facilities
year_6_target: Participating facilities meeting the defined standard; tenure documentation referred to state authorities
disaggregation: State, facility type, service functions provided
notes: Participation is voluntary and requires state and trustee consent, so the denominator is participating facilities, not all facilities.

definition: Proportion of Indian SPM leavers in a confirmed education, training or employment destination twelve months after leaving school
year_2_target: Destination tracking system operational; first cohort baseline published
year_4_target: Measurable improvement against the Year 2 baseline
year_6_target: Sustained improvement with the full series published
verification_source: Destination tracking survey; MOE and MOHE admissions data
notes: No numeric target is set before a baseline exists. Setting one would be an invented figure.

definition: Number of enrolees certified, and the proportion in employment at or above the indexed wage threshold twelve months after certification
year_2_target: Approximately 5,000 enrolees; completion rate published; tracking operational
year_4_target: Approximately 15,000 cumulative enrolees; completion rate at least 80%
year_6_target: Approximately 30,000 cumulative enrolees; at least 65% of certified graduates in employment at or above the indexed threshold twelve months after certification
measurement_frequency: Quarterly for enrolment; annual for employment
verification_source: Training provider records; EPF and SOCSO contribution matching for employment verification
disaggregation: Sector, gender, state, prior income band
notes: The employment threshold is the prevailing national minimum wage plus 25%, restated and published annually. Doc A's RM2,672 threshold was a 2014 statistic and is rejected (CNF-023). Completion and employment targets are set below Doc A's 85% and 70% because those figures had no evidential basis.

definition: Publication of an annual disaggregated intake and offer series; and the proportion of qualified Indian applicants receiving a confirmed place
baseline_value: Disputed and unpublished: 1,116 seats asserted by an NGO, 1,537 offers asserted in a source draft, neither traced to MOE
year_2_target: First official disaggregated intake and offer series published; navigation support operational
year_4_target: Full series published for three consecutive intakes; attrition point between qualification and enrolment identified
year_6_target: Series published annually as standing practice; measurable reduction in qualified applicants lost for procedural reasons
notes: Deliberately a TRANSPARENCY KPI, not a seat-count KPI. No additional seats are requested and the 90:10 framework is unchanged.

definition: Proportion of mentored graduates in professional employment within eighteen months
year_4_target: Baseline established from the first mentored cohort
year_6_target: Measurable improvement against the first-cohort baseline
verification_source: Graduate tracer study; professional association records
notes: No numeric target before a baseline exists.

definition: Proportion of enrolled households demonstrating measurable movement in at least two of: income stability, employment, savings, housing security, within 24 months of enrolment
year_2_target: Approximately 18,000 households enrolled; progression measurement framework operational; first cohort baseline
year_4_target: Approximately 40,000 households cumulatively enrolled; at least 40% of the Phase 1 cohort showing movement in two or more domains
year_6_target: Approximately 60,000 households cumulatively enrolled; at least 50% of households enrolled for 24 months or more showing movement in two or more domains
disaggregation: State, household composition, entry income band, gender of household head
notes: Coverage is capped at approximately 10% of the estimated low-income Indian household population and is NOT universal. Enrolment is voluntary and consent-based.

definition: Revenue and employment growth among participating enterprises; and the measured share and value of federal procurement awarded to certified Indian-owned vendors
baseline_value: Not measured; no certified register exists
year_4_target: Approximately 3,000 enterprises through advisory; certified vendor register operational; first procurement participation series published
year_6_target: Approximately 6,000 enterprises through advisory; sustained revenue and employment growth among participants; procurement participation published annually
data_owner: Ministry of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development
verification_source: SME Corp records; MOF procurement data; SSM and tax filings with consent
disaggregation: Sector, enterprise size, state, gender of owner
notes: Procurement participation is MEASURED AND PUBLISHED, not mandated. The 2% set-aside and RM100m contract-value targets in the source draft are rejected on Article 8 grounds (CNF-024).

definition: Proportion of participating households holding a defined minimum financial buffer
baseline_value: MIB 2017 set a target that at least 50% of registered poor households demonstrate increased savings within five years; no outturn was ever published
year_2_target: Approximately 15,000 households enrolled; product operational; baseline balances recorded
year_4_target: Approximately 35,000 households enrolled; at least 50% of households enrolled for 24 months or more showing increased savings
year_6_target: Approximately 50,000 households enrolled; at least 60% of households enrolled for 24 months or more holding the defined minimum buffer
verification_source: Product administrator records; participation and balance reporting
disaggregation: Income band, state, gender of account holder
notes: Instrument design requires MOF approval and, if PNB is the vehicle, PNB's own commercial agreement. Confidence class is Provisional.

definition: Number of assisted households in secure tenure through affordable housing or rent-to-own arrangements
year_2_target: Estate-displacement legacy review tabled; approximately 1,200 households assisted
year_4_target: Approximately 3,600 households cumulatively assisted; revised allocation criteria adopted in participating states
data_owner: Ministry of Housing and Local Government
verification_source: State housing agency records; SJKP data
notes: Volumes are set well below Doc A's 5,000 by Year 4 and 10,000 by Year 6 because delivery depends on state housing agency capacity and on land matters within state jurisdiction.

definition: Indian share of the federal civil service excluding RMP and MAF, reported alongside the absolute Indian officer headcount and the annual application volume
year_2_target: Application volumes published for the first time; grade-disaggregated composition series published; share at approximately 3.9%
year_6_target: Share in the range 4.2%-4.8%, equivalent to approximately 6,500-14,300 net additional Indian officers
disaggregation: Grade band, scheme of service, ministry, gender
notes: The MIB 7% target is NOT carried into MIB 2.0. Reaching 7% would require approximately 43,000 net additional officers, which is not deliverable in six years (ASM-020). Reported as BOTH a share and a headcount because the denominator will itself change (ASM-021).

definition: Distribution of Indian officers across grade bands
year_4_target: Grade-band distribution published annually; participation in development programmes published
year_6_target: Measurable improvement in the share of Indian officers in senior grade bands
disaggregation: Grade band, scheme of service, gender
notes: Principally a transparency deliverable. The first requirement is publication, which does not currently occur.

definition: Proportion of quarterly Task Force meetings held as scheduled and chaired as constituted; and dashboards published within 14 days of each meeting
year_2_target: 8 of 8 quarterly meetings held; 8 of 8 dashboards published within 14 days
year_4_target: 16 of 16 cumulative meetings held and dashboards published
year_6_target: 24 of 24 cumulative meetings held and dashboards published
notes: This is the single most predictive KPI in the register. Sustained quarterly PM chairmanship is the largest delivery risk in the portfolio (RSK-01).

definition: Proportion of the sixteen KPIs with a published verified baseline and a current published outturn
year_2_target: At least 12 of 16 KPIs with a published verified baseline; DPIA completed and published before any household record operates
year_4_target: 16 of 16 KPIs with published baselines and outturns; independent mid-term evaluation published
year_6_target: 16 of 16 maintained; independent final evaluation published
verification_source: Published dashboard; National Audit Department; independent evaluators
notes: Eleven of the sixteen KPIs currently have NO baseline. Establishing baselines is therefore the principal Phase 1 deliverable of the whole plan, and this is stated openly rather than concealed behind targets.
